nav.label: Site sections
footer.note: Fireemu is an independent open-source project, not an official Google or Firebase product.
landing.title: Fireemu — Test against Firebase as it behaves in production
landing.description: An unofficial local Firebase emulator for automated tests and CI that targets documented production Firebase behavior.
landing.h1: Test against Firebase as it behaves in production
landing.lede: An unofficial, single-binary Firebase emulator for tests and CI. Its default strict profile follows production validation and error shapes within the documented scope, so more issues show up locally before you deploy.
landing.runTestsMeta: Starts Fireemu, runs your tests, then stops.
landing.feature.index.title: Missing composite indexes
landing.feature.index.body: Under the default strict settings, queries that need an undeclared composite index fail with FAILED_PRECONDITION instead of running unnoticed.
landing.feature.totp.title: TOTP multi-factor auth
landing.feature.totp.body: Enroll and sign in with TOTP second factors directly through the Firebase SDK.
landing.feature.blocking.title: Blocking functions and account policies
landing.feature.blocking.body: Test sign-up and sign-in blocking functions and, under strict, beforeEmailSent for password-reset and email sign-in messages, along with account settings like disabling user-initiated account deletion.
landing.feature.scheduled.title: Scheduled functions on a virtual clock
landing.feature.scheduled.body: Advance emulator time to trigger Node.js scheduled functions on demand, including time zone rules and catch-up runs.
landing.feature.search.title: Enterprise full-text search
landing.feature.search.body: Run supported Firestore Enterprise text-search queries locally. Scoring is approximate, with known differences in Japanese/CJK tokenization.
landing.time.title: Advance the clock instead of waiting
landing.time.p1: Freeze, set, or advance the emulator clock to test token expiry, TTL, and scheduled Node.js functions without waiting for real time to pass.
landing.time.p2: In the Emulator UI, set the clock, run a scheduled function manually, or advance straight to its next scheduled run.
landing.worlds.title: Run integration tests in parallel
landing.worlds.p1: Each test world has its own data, Security Rules, Functions, ports, and clock, even when tests share the same project ID. Data edits and clock moves stay inside that world.
landing.worlds.p2: withTestWorld starts the world and cleans it up when the test finishes, even after a failure.
landing.worlds.boundary: Both scripts use the demo-app project ID in separate worlds. Advancing the clock in one callback does not affect the other.
landing.verification.intro: Fireemu’s responses are compared with recordings from real Firebase projects. The published records describe the conditions checked, reviewed differences, and work still in progress.
landing.step.record.title: Record
landing.step.record.body: Capture responses from real Firebase projects.
landing.step.compare.title: Compare
landing.step.compare.body: Check local behavior against those recordings.
landing.step.publish.title: Publish
landing.step.publish.body: Document verified conditions and known differences in the repo.
landing.verification.boundary: Verification covers the recorded scope, not every Firebase feature or input. Before relying solely on local tests in CI, run critical flows against a dedicated Firebase test project rather than live production.
landing.differs.title: Intentional local defaults
landing.differs.p1: Some production setup is relaxed by default so tests run without boilerplate. Features like MFA and multi-tenancy start enabled, and documented settings let you switch back to production setup checks whenever needed.
landing.differs.p2: Other behavior remains approximate or outside the local runtime, including text analysis, real quota accounting and cloud infrastructure. We distinguish these limits from behavior that is not yet implemented or verified.
landing.services.intro: Each product guide lists supported APIs, configuration options, and known limits.
landing.service.firestore.name: Cloud Firestore
landing.service.firestore.covers: Standard and Enterprise editions, composite index checks, queries, and Security Rules.
landing.service.firestore.limit: Enterprise pipelines and text search have a documented scope.
landing.service.auth.name: Firebase Authentication
landing.service.auth.covers: Identity Platform settings, sign-in methods, TOTP/SMS MFA, multi-tenancy, and blocking functions.
landing.service.auth.limit: Live round-trips to external identity providers are outside the local runtime.
landing.service.storage.name: Cloud Storage
landing.service.storage.covers: Firebase and JSON APIs, object operations, and Security Rules.
landing.service.storage.limit: V2 and POST policy signatures, IAM, and managed notifications are out of scope.
landing.service.functions.name: Cloud Functions
landing.service.functions.covers: Node.js and Python functions: HTTP, callable, event, blocking, scheduled, and task-queue triggers (Cloud Tasks).
landing.service.pubsub.name: Cloud Pub/Sub
landing.service.pubsub.covers: Topics, subscriptions, push/pull delivery, dead-letter topics, and StreamingPull.
landing.service.pubsub.limit: Schemas, BigQuery/Storage delivery, and exactly-once delivery are not supported.
landing.service.eventarc.name: Eventarc
landing.service.eventarc.covers: Custom events, channels, and event delivery to local Functions.
landing.service.eventarc.limit: See the guide for supported event types and auth settings.
landing.service.rtdb.name: Realtime Database
landing.service.rtdb.covers: REST and realtime protocols, Security Rules, export, and import.
landing.service.rtdb.limit: Verified against production for recorded cases; no parity claim against the official emulator.
landing.service.hosting.name: Firebase Hosting
landing.service.hosting.covers: Static files, redirects, rewrites, headers, clean URLs, and localization.
landing.service.hosting.limit: Verified against production for recorded cases; no parity claim against the official emulator.
landing.service.appcheck.name: Firebase App Check
landing.service.appcheck.covers: Debug-token exchange and configurable enforcement for Authentication, Firestore, Storage, and callable functions.
landing.service.appcheck.limit: Real-device attestation and limited-use replay protection are not supported.
landing.services.notSupported: Not currently supported: App Hosting and Data Connect.
landing.workflow.install.title: Install
landing.workflow.install.body: Add fireemu to devDependencies and run init to generate fireemu.toml.
landing.workflow.connect.title: Connect
landing.workflow.connect.body: Point client SDKs at the local ports. Under exec, the Admin SDK connects automatically.
landing.workflow.run.title: Run tests
landing.workflow.run.body: Run tests through fireemu exec. It starts the emulators, runs your command, and exits with its status code.
landing.workflow.ci.title: Use in CI
landing.workflow.ci.body: Run the same exec command in CI, with config lint and environment checks to catch setup drift.
landing.migrate: Already using the Firebase Local Emulator Suite? Fireemu reads your existing firebase.json directly.
